      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import mglearn\n",
        "import tensorflow as tf\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import fetch_lfw_people\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
        "from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.layers import Input, Dense\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "PGEwPmIIKK9p"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "np.random.seed(180)\n",
        "tf.random.set_seed(180)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "4YcqhbEEKTVN"
      },
      "execution_count": 7,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "people = fetch_lfw_people(\n",
        "  min_faces_per_person=20,\n",
        "  resize=0.7\n",
        " )\n",
        "print(people.data.shape)\n",
        "print(people.target.shape)\n",
        "image_shape = people.images[0].shape\n"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "  people.data,\n",
        "  people.target,\n",
        "  test_size=0.2,\n",
        "  random_state=20\n",

        "y_train = y_train.astype(int)\n",
        "y_test = y_test.astype(int)\n",
        "batch_size = len(X_train)\n",

        "X_train.shape,\n",
        "y_train.shape,\n",
        "y_test.shape\n",
        "  )\n",

    {

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "mask = np.zeros(\n",
        "  people.target.shape,\n",
        "  dtype=np.bool_\n",
        "  )\n",
        "for target in np.unique(people.target):\n",
        " mask[\n",
        "  np.where(people.target == target)[0][:50]\n",
        "  ] = True\n",
        "X_people = people.data[mask]\n",
        "y_people = people.target[mask]\n",
        "  # Scale pixel values\n",
        "X_people = X_people / 255.0\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9cVA5otJMbyo"
      },
      "execution_count": 22,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "  X_people,\n",
        "  y_people,\n",
        "  stratify=y_people,\n",
        "  random_state=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "# KNN without PCA\n",
        "knn = KNeighborsClassifier(\n",
        "n_neighbors=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "knn.fit(\n",
        "X_train,\n",
        "y_train\n",
        ")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "\"Test set score of 1-nn: {:.2f}\".format(\n",
        "knn.score(\n",
        "X_test,\n",
        "y_test\n",
        ")\n",
        ")\n",
        ")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

        "id": "Zx25tI-rMmPg",

          ]
        }

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "mglearn.plots.plot_pca_whitening()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "pca = PCA(\n",
        "  n_components=100,\n",
        "  whiten=True,\n",
        "  random_state=0\n",
        "  ).fit(X_train)\n",
        "X_train_pca = pca.transform(X_train)\n",
        "X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test)\n",
        "print(\n",
        "\"X_train_pca.shape: {}\".format(\n",
        "X_train_pca.shape\n",
        ")\n",
        ")\n",
        "# KNN with PCA\n",
        "knn = KNeighborsClassifier(\n",
        "n_neighbors=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "knn.fit(\n",
        "X_train_pca,\n",
        "y_train\n",
        ")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "\"Test set accuracy: {:.2f}\".format(\n",
        "knn.score(\n",
        "X_test_pca,\n",
        "y_test\n",
        ")\n",
        ")\n",
        ")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "\"pca.components_.shape: {}\".format(\n",
        "pca.components_.shape ))\n"
      ],

        "fix, axes = plt.subplots(\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Scaling PCA features\n",
        "scaler = MinMaxScaler()\n",
        "X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(\n",
        "X_train_pca\n",
        ")\n",
        "X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(\n",
        "X_test_pca\n",
        ")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "kfUI37ObOBPm"
      },
      "execution_count": 32,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model = Sequential([\n",
        "  Input(\n",
        "  shape=(100,)\n",
        "  ),\n",
        "  Dense(\n",
        "  300,\n",
        "  activation='relu'\n",
        "  ),\n",
        "  Dense(\n",
        "  100,\n",
        "  activation='relu'\n",
        "  ),\n",
        "  Dense(\n",
        "  len(np.unique(y_train)),\n",
        "  activation='softmax'\n",
        "  )\n",
        "  ])\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "jJWJOuoQODbx"
      },
      "execution_count": 33,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model.compile(optimizer='adam',loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy',metrics=['accuracy'])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "owI6A-rgOIr8"
      },
      "execution_count": 34,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
